text:
Mina (Prod): Dropping a fresh Figma iteration for the model catalog compare UI. Focus: quicker skimming, clearer badges for perf vs cost, and an explicit pin/promote flow. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 (open comments)
Diego (Design): Love the compact compare row. A few ideas: show filter chips above table with X selected, add a tiny export icon to copy current compare view to CSV/clipboard.
Casey (FE): Export OK. Quick question: should export include raw metric timestamps? I can wire it to CSV with header columns. Also prefer CSS grid for metric columns for easier horizontal scroll.
Ivy (Backend): We can return metric timestamps. Proposed API snippet (we should standardize keys):
```json
{
  "serving_metrics": {
    "latency": {"p50": 42, "p95": 120},
    "cost_per_1k": 0.12,
    "snapshot_ts": "2026-03-01T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```
Diego (Design): Nice. For badges: prefer dual-line badge — first line big metric (e.g., "42ms p50"), second line small text ("p95 120ms · $0.12/1k"). Use icon+shape so colorblind folks get meaning (circle/triangle/square).
Noah (QA): Accessibility checklist: badges must expose accessible name and value. e.g., aria-label="Latency p50 42 milliseconds, p95 120 milliseconds, cost zero point one two dollars per thousand tokens". Also export must be reachable by keyboard.
Casey (FE): Will add aria-labels and a visually-hidden description. For large compares (100+ rows) we should virtualize — also add a "density" small control (compact/comfortable) to change row height.
Priya (PM): Pinning UX question: is "Pin" a local bookmark, or does it change traffic? Suggest: Pin = personal quick access; Promote = route-level default. Both in quick menu.
Mina (Prod): Agree. UI labels: "Pin (you)" and "Promote to route". Promote opens modal describing rollout and audit entry.
Diego (Design): Visual affordance: pinned rows get a subtle stripe and a top-left pin icon. Promoted models show a tiny badge "default" with tooltip that links to rollout controls.
Ivy (Backend): Backend needs to store pin metadata separately: personal_pins[], and route_defaults[]. Also will return "metrics_freshness_days" so frontend can flag stale data.
Casey (FE): Suggest showing a tiny clock icon with age hover: "metrics snapshot 3d old". If >7d show orange border.
Noah (QA): Test cases: 1) Keyboard: open row actions -> promote -> confirm modal. 2) Screen reader: reads pin state and badge content in logical order. 3) Export CSV includes snapshot_ts column.
Priya (PM): Copy nit: change badge microcopy from "est cost" to "est $ / 1k" for brevity. Also the filter clear action should be obvious: "Clear filters (esc)" hint.
Diego (Design): On mobile, collapse compare to stacked cards; include a top pill that toggles "show metrics" to keep it lightweight.
Mina (Prod): Quick poll: thumbs for export CSV, metric timestamps, dual-level pin/promote, and accessibility bits?
Diego (Design): :thumbsup:
Casey (FE): :thumbsup:
Ivy (Backend): :thumbsup:
Noah (QA): :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): :thumbsup:
Mina (Prod): Great. I'll author the tiny spec for API field names and the PRD for front-end. Scheduling a short demo tomorrow.
